name: X Live Search Vibe Code Pack 🐦
description_md:
## What You Get

- A comprehensive Cheat Sheet Guide (Google Doc) detailing every prompt and step to build the UI foundation, deploy a Supabase edge function, and configure n8n for a serverless alert system.

- The fully importable n8n workflow JSON file (Live Search Grok API), ready to drop into your n8n instance for instant real-time X data streaming Live_Search_Workflow.json

- Pre-configured “Pulse Agent” logic that maps alert-card presets (Tech Updates, Breaking News, Memes & Trends, etc.) to Grok Live Search, Anthropic reasoning, and GraphQL wrappers.

If you're looking for a version of this you can directly chat with, vibe coding coaching, and TONs of exclusive goodies, consider joining my Early AI-dopters Community. You won't regret it 😉
